notes: This contract traces Umbra's private 2025 MOM service-report routing, serial-reservation, immutable filesystem initial-record, and unpublished joined-federate MOM-object foundation to the Requirements Lab export. The registered Catch2 evidence covers MIM-driven class/parameter lookup, private normalized DDM point routing, explicit RTI source separation without a numeric federate sentinel, mutually exclusive sink selection, per-federate serial allocation, a real per-joined-federate filesystem record created even when file reporting starts disabled, and a registry-owned snapshot with a common object identity, immutable HLAfederate point, complete effective-attribute metadata, exact report-file value, and the Join-scoped federate FOM-designator list used by both representations. It proves neither an emitted Receive Interaction callback nor public MOM registration/discovery/reflection/HLAreportServiceFile publication. The 11.5.2 candidate titles currently point to an unrelated Annex source (RL-041), while public RTI-created callback producer identity remains unresolved (RL-043), so the object-foundation and file-lifecycle entries are source-level traceability only. It is not a Requirements Lab validation record or conformance claim.
